Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class AdminService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.AdminService
public final class AdminService extends Object
Admin-only actions. Every method first checks that admin is an active Admin account (AccessControl) and throws SecurityException otherwise, before changing anything. Each action saves through the stores and sends the notification or audit entry that goes with it, so the admin screens only collect input and call these.

    • takeDownListing

      public void takeDownListing(User admin, Listing listing, String reason)
      Takes a listing off the marketplace (SRS UC-3.7 S1): stores the reason and the Taken Down status, records it in the audit log, resolves the open reports with "Listing taken down", declines the pending and countered requests, and notifies those buyers and the seller. The listing keeps its deals, chats and reports.

      A Reserved or Lent listing first has its active deal cancelled (SRS UC-3.7 A2); the decided request and deal stay in history. Other statuses cannot be taken down (A3).

      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin
      listing - the Live, Reserved or Lent listing to take down
      reason - the take-down reason stored on the listing

    • editListing

      public void editListing(User admin, Listing listing, String title, String description, Category category, Condition condition, Location location, String rawPrice, Duration lendingDuration)
      Edits a listing's details without changing its status (SRS UC-3.7 S1), then audits the change and notifies the seller. Prices and lending durations keep their existing rules. The listing keeps its current photos.
      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin
      listing - the listing to edit
      title - the new title
      description - the new description
      category - the new category
      condition - the new condition
      location - the new meetup location
      rawPrice - the new asking price for a Sale listing; ignored for other types
      lendingDuration - the new duration for a Lend listing; ignored for other types

    • editListing

      public void editListing(User admin, Listing listing, String title, String description, Category category, Condition condition, Location location, String rawPrice, Duration lendingDuration, List<String> keptPhotoPaths, List<PhotoDraft> newPhotos, PhotoStorage photos)
      Edits a listing's details and photos without changing its status (SRS UC-3.7 step 3.1.2), then audits the change and notifies the seller. The admin keeps some of the listing's existing photo paths and adds new JPEG/PNG files, with at most six photos in total (SRS UC-3.7 A4). New photos are stored under the listing's seller and id.

      Removed photos only leave the listing's stored paths; the files on disk are kept.

      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin
      listing - the listing to edit
      title - the new title
      description - the new description
      category - the new category
      condition - the new condition
      location - the new meetup location
      rawPrice - the new asking price for a Sale listing; ignored for other types
      lendingDuration - the new duration for a Lend listing; ignored for other types
      keptPhotoPaths - the existing photo paths that stay on the listing
      newPhotos - the newly chosen photo files to store
      photos - storage for the new photos; may be null when none are added
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the combined photos exceed six, a new file is not a supported JPEG/PNG, or a text/price/duration rule fails

    • dismissReports

      public int dismissReports(User admin, Listing listing, String note)
      Dismisses every open report on the listing with one resolution note (SRS UC-3.7 steps 3.3.2-3.3.3) and records it in the audit log. The listing itself is unchanged.
      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin
      listing - the reported listing
      note - the resolution note stored on every open report
      Returns:
      how many reports were resolved
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - with RESOLUTION_NOTE_REQUIRED if the note is blank (A6)
      IllegalStateException - if the listing has no open reports

      Adds a listing for a seller from the admin screen, saved as Live (SRS UC-3.7), and audits it. The seller is told, so they know the listing exists under their name.

    • addAccount

      public User addAccount(User admin, UserRole role, String username, String fullName, String password, String residenceHall, String bio, Location meetup)
      Adds a buyer or seller account from the admin screen (SRS UC-3.4). The username must be unused and the password must pass every rule; the role never changes later.
      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin
      role - BUYER or SELLER (never ADMIN)
      username - the new unique username
      fullName - the account's full name
      password - the plain-text password, hashed before storage
      residenceHall - the buyer's residence hall, or null
      bio - the seller's bio, or null
      meetup - the seller's preferred meetup location, or null
      Returns:
      the saved account

    • updateAccount

      public void updateAccount(User admin, User account, String fullName, String residenceHall, String bio, Location meetup)
      Edits an account's full name and role-specific fields (SRS UC-3.4). The username, role and status are not editable here, and the admin account is changed from its own profile screen.
      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin
      account - the buyer or seller to edit
      fullName - the new full name
      residenceHall - the new residence hall for a buyer, or null
      bio - the new bio for a seller, or null
      meetup - the new preferred meetup for a seller, or null to keep the current one

    • setActive

      public void setActive(User admin, User account, boolean active)
      Activates or deactivates a buyer or seller account (SRS UC-3.4). A deactivated account can no longer log in and its listings stop being browsable through their account status; the listings themselves keep their statuses. The admin account is protected.
      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin
      account - the buyer or seller to activate or deactivate
      active - true to activate, false to deactivate

    • accountActivity

      public AdminService.AccountActivity accountActivity(User admin, User account)
      What the soft-delete warning lists before the admin confirms (SRS UC-3.3 S1).
      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin
      account - the account that would be deleted
      Returns:
      the activity that soft delete would close

    • softDeleteAccount

      public void softDeleteAccount(User admin, User account)
      Soft-deletes an account (SRS UC-3.3): live and pending listings are taken down with "Seller account deleted", open requests are declined, active deals cancelled, the affected users notified, the profile fields cleared, and an audit entry written. Historical deals, reviews and chats keep pointing at the account, which now reads "deleted user".
      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin
      account - the buyer or seller to soft-delete

    • setReviewHidden

      public void setReviewHidden(User admin, Review review, boolean hidden)
      Hides or unhides a review; hidden reviews leave the seller's rating (SRS UC-3.6).
      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin
      review - the review to change
      hidden - true to hide, false to show

    • updateProfile

      public List<String> updateProfile(User admin, String fullName, String currentPassword, String newPassword, String confirmPassword)
      Saves the admin's own profile (SRS UC-3.4). The full name must not be whitespace only; a password change needs the current password and both new-password fields.
      Parameters:
      admin - the acting admin, also the account being changed
      fullName - the new full name
      currentPassword - the current password, needed only when changing the password
      newPassword - the new password, or blank to keep the current one
      confirmPassword - the new password again
      Returns:
      the names of the fields that changed, empty when nothing changed
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - with the reason if a check fails; nothing changes
